BEGIN PHASE B. Execute the Vietnam thermal inventory in structured waves. TURN 1 — COAL DISCOVERY: Search for Vietnam's operating, under-construction, and planned coal-fired power plants. Focus on: (a) PDP8 Decision 500/2023 coal plant lists and status updates (b) Global Coal Plant Tracker Vietnam entries for cross-reference leads (c) Recent news (2024-2026) on coal plant cancellations, conversions, or new CODs For each plant found, record: Vietnamese name, English name, province, capacity, units, technology, status, COD, owner, and source. Flag any conflicts or uncertainties. TURN 2 — GAS/LNG DISCOVERY: Repeat for gas-fired plants (domestic gas CCGT/OCGT and LNG-to-power projects). Search for: (a) PDP8 gas/LNG plant lists (b) Operating gas plants (Phu My, Ca Mau, Nhon Trach, Ba Ria complex) (c) LNG terminal and power projects pipeline (Bac Lieu, Son My, Hai Lang, etc.) (d) Recent status changes TURN 3 — GAPS AND VERIFICATION: Search for any missing assets, resolve conflicts found in turns 1-2, verify disputed attributes. Then compile the complete inventory table, per-asset notes, and bibliography into the final Markdown report.
